# Tailzu message sheet

## One-liner

Typing Hinglish or an Indian language on a keyboard is slow, and plain dictation writes down every 'um'. Tailzu is a voice keyboard: you talk the way you talk and it writes the message clean, in any app, so you say it badly and send it perfect.

| Problem | Solution | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Typing Hinglish or an Indian language on a keyboard is slow, and plain dictation writes down every 'um'. | Tailzu is a voice keyboard: you talk the way you talk and it writes the message clean, in any app, | so you say it badly and send it perfect. |

## Positioning

| | |
|---|---|
| Who it's for | People who would rather say a message than type it: Hindi, Hinglish and Indian-language speakers who write all day on their phone and computer, in WhatsApp, mail, Slack, AI chats and code editors. |
| In one sentence | Tailzu is a voice keyboard: talk in Hindi, Hinglish, any of India's 22 scheduled languages or English, and clean, ready-to-send text lands in any app. |
| In one paragraph | Tailzu is an AI voice keyboard for iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac. You speak the way you speak, in Hindi, Hinglish, any of India's 22 scheduled languages, English or 23 more languages, and clean, ready-to-send text lands where your cursor is: filler gone, punctuation in, names and numbers kept exactly as you said them. Hinglish stays Hinglish, and it writes in the native script or in English letters. It cleans; it never rewrites. On a computer you tap Ctrl twice, talk, and the text is pasted at the cursor. 800 words a month are free. |
| Category | Voice keyboard (AI voice typing) |
| Different from | Dictation that types every 'um' and forces one language at a time, and translators that turn your words into someone else's. Tailzu keeps your mix of languages and your exact names and amounts, and only cleans. |

## Copy limits by format

Words allowed per part (0 = leave it out).

| Format | Headline | Subhead | Body | CTA | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billboard / large outdoor | 7 | 0 | 0 | 4 | One idea, one image. CTA is a short URL or handle. |
| Poster (A3, A2, 18x24 in) | 10 | 18 | 40 | 6 | Readable from 3 m. Details (date, place, URL) go in small type. |
| Event poster | 8 | 15 | 30 | 6 | Details must include date, time and place. |
| Instagram / LinkedIn post (on-image text) | 8 | 12 | 25 | 5 | The caption is separate; its first line (about 125 characters) shows before 'more'. |
| Instagram / Facebook story, Reel cover | 8 | 10 | 15 | 4 | Keep text out of the top and bottom 250 px (interface overlays). |
| Carousel slide | 10 | 15 | 40 | 5 | First slide is the hook; last slide carries the CTA. |
| YouTube thumbnail | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Three to five big words, maximum. |
| Display banner | 6 | 8 | 0 | 3 | CTA as a button. |
| Website hero section | 10 | 25 | 50 | 4 | Headline: what you offer. Subhead: how life gets better. Button: the next step. |
| Email header and subject | 9 | 15 | 80 | 4 | Subject line under about 50 characters. |
| Flyer (A5, A4) | 12 | 20 | 150 | 8 | Use subheads to break body copy. |
| Long-copy print ad | 16 | 25 | 600 | 10 | Image, headline, body, then logo and CTA. Caption every image. |
